stages.title: Static Screen / Initial Impression

questions.title: Recognize READY State
questions.description: Does the participant understand that the device is in standby?

stages.emotion: How clear and intuitive is the initial screen?

stages.title: Dynamic Fan Speed

questions.title: Recognize RUN State
questions.description: Can the participant recognize the fan is running?

questions.title: Identify Speed Changes
questions.description: Can they distinguish low, medium and high speeds?

questions.title: Match Animation with Sound
questions.description: Do animation speed and sound intensity/pitch feel consistent?

stages.emotion: How clear and natural does the speed feedback feel?

stages.title: Dynamic Fan Opening

questions.title: Recognize RUN State
questions.description: Can the participant tell that the fan is still running?

questions.title: Recognize Opening Change
questions.description: Can they recognize the increase or decrease of the opening?

stages.emotion: How intuitive is the opening feedback?

stages.title: Charging While Idle

questions.title: Recognize Charging State
questions.description: Can the participant recognize charging while idle?

questions.title: Identify Battery Information
questions.description: Can they locate and understand the battery level?

stages.emotion: How clear is the charging feedback when the fan is stopped?

stages.title: Charging While Running

questions.title: Recognize Combined State
questions.description: Can they recognize that the fan is running and charging simultaneously?

questions.title: Identify Primary Information
questions.description: Can they understand both speed and charging information?

stages.emotion: How confident are you in understanding the combined state?

stages.title: Low Battery Alert

questions.title: Notice Low Battery Transition
questions.description: Does the participant notice the LOW BATTERY change without prompting?

questions.title: Recognize Low Battery Warning
questions.description: Can they explain what LOW BATTERY means?

questions.title: Identify Battery Level
questions.description: Can they identify the percentage and understand that it is low?

stages.emotion: How noticeable and understandable is the low battery warning?

stages.title: Symbol & Pixel Graphics Comprehension
stages.scenario: Isolated UI Elements · Without explanatory labels

questions.title: Interpret Pixel Fan Symbol
questions.description: Recognize that the central pixel graphic represents a fan

questions.title: Distinguish Rotation Speed
questions.description: Identify faster and slower animations without speed numbers

questions.title: Recognize Pixel Battery Indicator
questions.description: Understand that the pixel symbol/numbers represent battery level

stages.emotion: How intuitive are the pixel graphics and symbols?

finals.text: What information was easiest to understand?
Which UI element attracted too much attention?
What would you change about this interface?
How satisfied are you with the overall interface?

P01.attentionNote::s1: 第一眼能识别，但是不知道数字具体是什么？其他的都差不多
P01.note::2.5: 当有噪音匹配时候，能够立即意识到风扇，然后立刻理解大数字的含义，但没有看到实物，认为像是气罐或是什么能源。
P01.note::3.4: 能够识别这个是什么但是不知道含义。
P01.attentionNote::s4: 能看到加号在动，但是太小了
P01.attentionNote::s5: 这次数字动的慢了，能更好识别加号在动，但还是有点小
P01.note::5.3: 动态识别在工作，发现了正在充电
P01.note::6.5: 看到数字低于20，自动认为低电量了
P01.note::7.1: 动起来的时候很有帮助
P01.final::F2: 开度，也许有物理模拟会更直观
P01.final::F3: 开度，当开度大了以后，变成视觉重心了
P01.final::F4: low时候变成红色，加号放大，动效给足，开度做成框，state放大

P02.note::1.3: 最后看到，但是符合我的设计想法
